content.title: Walmart Supercenter in Front Royal, VA | Grocery, Electronics, Toys | Serving Riverton | Store 5105
content.text: Front Royal Walmart SupercenterSimplify your shopping. You’ll spend less time, and less money when you take advantage of the shopping and services at your Front Royal Walmart Supercenter. We’re located where it’s convenient for you, at 10 Riverton Commons Drive, Front Royal, VA 22630. That’s less than a mile from the intersection of US-522 and I-66 in Warren County. We’ve got your clothing, groceries, toys, office supplies, bakeware, kitchen tools, bedding, and electronics all under one roof. And, while you’re shopping, take care of your Pharmacy, Bakery, Deli needs and visit our Wireless Services. Schedule your car in at our Auto Care Center and shop while we take care of your car maintenance. Main Supercenter HoursWe know how busy life gets and we want to help simplify things. We’re open early in the morning, and we stay open late at night just so you won’t have to worry about getting your shopping done. You can shop right from 6 a.m. all the way to 11 p.m. Monday through Sunday. The Pharmacy is available from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. Saturday, and 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Sunday. Our Auto Care Center is conveniently open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. so you won’t have to rush to get your car in. Some of our departments have different hours and you can confirm those by calling us at 540-635-4140. Departments & Services at This LocationYour Front Royal Walmart Supercenter can help make life better with excellent selection in all our departments, as well as affordable prices. We’ve also got the services you count on most, all right here in one single spot. Whether you’re picking up groceries, a gift, clothing for the kids, sports equipment, art supplies, cleaning supplies, or craft items, we can help. While you’re here, make sure you stop by the Deli and the Bakery, and save yourself some cooking. You can also have your car serviced, get your prescriptions filled, and pick up new glasses right here. Don’t forget to pick up your alcohol too, which is also on site.
